personas.connection_goal: Find someone to attend Australian rules football matches, watch major sporting events and occasionally join casual social sport.
personas.motivation: Sport is one of my main ways of spending time with friends. I enjoy the atmosphere and conversation more than aggressive rivalry.
contributions: Reliable company for matches and events
Friendly discussion about teams, tactics and sporting history
expectations: Respectful behaviour towards players, officials and other supporters
personas.communication_style: Informal, concise and friendly. I prefer practical messages about plans rather than constant group chat.
boundaries: Abusive language toward players or officials (-0.9)
personas.initial_disclosure: I will initially share broad sporting interests, preferred event types and general availability. I will not disclose precise routines, financial information or contact details until mutual trust develops.

personas.connection_goal: Meet someone interested in Melbourne's neighbourhoods, live music, comedy, food, coffee, galleries and local events.
personas.motivation: I enjoy discovering places through shared experiences and conversation, particularly smaller venues and neighbourhood events rather than formal networking.
contributions: Familiarity with Melbourne neighbourhoods and venues
Curiosity about food, music, design and local history
expectations: Openness to different neighbourhoods and cultural interests
Respect for different tastes and budgets
personas.communication_style: Relaxed and conversational. I like short messages followed by in-person experiences rather than long online discussions.
boundaries: Snobbery about taste, suburb or income (-0.9)
Disrespectful behaviour toward hospitality or venue staff (-0.9)
personas.initial_disclosure: I will share interests, broad neighbourhood preferences and activity ideas. My home address, family details and regular schedule remain private initially.

personas.connection_goal: Find a dependable person for weekend walks, moderate hikes, coastal day trips and occasional cycling around Melbourne and regional Victoria.
personas.motivation: Outdoor activities are a good way to maintain health, explore Victoria and build friendship without requiring constant social contact.
contributions: Moderate fitness and willingness to adjust pace
Interest in scenery, wildlife and photography
expectations: Honest communication about fitness and experience
Respect for weather, track conditions and safety advice
personas.communication_style: Friendly, direct and low-maintenance. I prefer plans made in advance and do not expect immediate replies.
boundaries: Sharing precise routines or locations without consent (-0.9)
personas.initial_disclosure: I will share general activity preferences, approximate fitness level and broad availability. I will not initially share my home address, exact routine or private family information.
